stem:
Harsh cycles at a steady speed of 4 m/s for 50 s. He knows the speed and the time and wants the distance covered.

What should he do?

options.text: Multiply 4 m/s by 50 s to get 200 m.
Divide 50 s by 4 m/s to get 12.5 m.
Divide 4 m/s by 50 s to get 0.08 m.
Add 4 m/s to 50 s to get 54 m.

teacher.key_rationale: Distance equals speed times time: 4 × 50 = 200 m. Dividing either way or adding mixes the quantities.
